The Climate Question Hanging Over Anthropic’s IPO

From a business, economics, or technology angle, the record-breaking Anthropic IPO is one of the biggest stories of the year. Raising around $81 billion, it was the biggest IPO of all time. And it’s perhaps the cleanest signal of how interwoven the economy has become with AI. But the Anthropic IPO also provides an important lens into this moment for energy and climate .
